name: RRSOS PCC Mod Manager
description: A Manage Mods button on the main menu, above Quit. It opens a screen with every loaded mod on the left and its settings on the right: switches, choices and text boxes change the setting through BepInEx (applied at once and saved to the mod's .cfg), with a Reset for each. A mod can also be switched off or on for the next start, which moves its folder out of or back into BepInEx\plugins (to plugins-disabled).
